_source: Trinity's own Google Business Profile, exported via Google Takeout 2026-08-10. Verbatim, unedited. 706 reviews in the export; these are a curated 60.
_note: Owner-exported data, NOT the Google Places API, so the Places caching restrictions do not apply. Do not edit the text of any review. Order matters: the homepage marquee renders the first 45 and clamps at 7 lines; anything that renders longer than 7 lines at 340px belongs in the tail, which only /about/reviews/ shows unclamped.
